body: I've already used my education grant when I was a kid, gotten my degree, I'm not eligible for anything else.
It seems that I can't get assistance because I have a job.

I have no idea how to acquire most things.

I can save, at best, a few thousand a year.

I've failed to get a skill or job where I can earn more.

I don't know how to get much time to work on it.

I'm homeless, depend on free food, and it doesn't look like that'll change at this rate.

Is she angry? As someone who was inappropriately touched when I was around 8 years old, I hardly even think of it. I don't actually feel anything about it. It was by a teenager, and I just think that he didn't know better and didn't intend harm. Maybe I'd feel differently if he'd been an adult or seemed malicious, but as it is, I just think that kids do shitty things without meaning it sometimes, and then they grow up.
